The honest part

Read this and don't forget it.
• Sportsbook lines are set and corrected by sharp money. The closing line beats nearly all private models.
• At standard −110 pricing you need ~52.4% just to break even.
• Books limit or ban people who win consistently.
• Most bettors lose money over time. A few dozen bets tells you nothing.
• This tool does analysis. It is not financial advice and it does not predict winners — nothing can do that reliably.

Before you start

This is a tool for analysing bets honestly — including telling you when you're losing. Please take a second with the reality first.
Most people who bet lose money. Winning consistently is rare, and books limit those who do. At −110 you need ~52.4% just to break even, and the closing line beats almost all private models. This app never predicts winners and is not financial advice.
Everything stays on this device. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
